title: The deformation fibre category is a predeformation category
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file artin.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Verifies the two axioms: (a) cofibred in groupoids over C_Lambda because X is fibred in groupoids and the pullback to Spec(k) is unique up to isomorphism, giving pushforwards via the dual fibred-category lemma; (b) F(k) is equivalent to a point since any morphism x_0 -> x over Spec(k) = Spec(A) is an isomorphism of X (fibred in groupoids), and the only self-morphism of x_0 is the identity.
